plan.purpose: Fixed-setting development-only comparison with all anchor and correction work charged; no attempt to reproduce untraceable MimeLite claims
plan.budget_rationale: 23.1M is divisible by both MimeLite round costs (550k and 700k). FedAvg has 115 full rounds plus 10 local steps in round 116; full MIME has 25 full rounds plus 5 local steps in round 26. No wasted anchor-only padding and no discarded gradients.
plan.settings: Reuse frozen 500k fit, 399552 development, 39-feature LayerNorm MLP, loss, batch500, 20 full-participation clients, population weights, initializations and ownership. MimeLite uses the full-MIME lagged-v Adam base: beta1=.9, beta2=.99, epsilon=.001, initial_v=.0001; state fixed within each local block, one full-anchor server-state update per round.
plan.learning_rates: Existing arms retain historical fixed rates. Both MimeLite variants use the existing MIME/central-base rate .003. No new rate sweep, best-epoch selection or equal-optimization-effort claim.
plan.sampling: Existing deterministic per-seed, round, client and step streams. Equal-K local methods share sampled local rows for common rounds; different K/anchor budgets imply different total sampled exposure. Centralized sampling remains pooled.
plan.evaluation: Final endpoints only, development full argmax plus grouped development-audit operating points. Same benign-only calibration partition and targets 1/5/10/20 percent; primary 5 percent. Actual FAR and every class recall reported. Already exposed development; no independent test claim.
plan.communication: Report round count and logical barriers separately. Count all FP32 model/moment/anchor/model messages, not measured traffic. Equal backward work is not equal wall time, FLOPs, message volume, local steps, optimizer calls or unique examples.
plan.historical_bridge: Five existing arms must reproduce the historical 21.6M model, logits, metrics, sample stream and work before continuing to the new budget, for all three seeds.
